reason: Re-opened packet.js pali 21: the Pali on 294 (Tattha sānucaranti ... ayametthattho) carries the evidence verbatim: taṇhā mātā nāma, asmimāno pitā nāma, dve sassatucchedadiṭṭhiyo dve khattiyarājāno nāma, dvādasāyatanāni ... raṭṭhaṃ nāma, and etesaṃ taṇhādīnaṃ arahattamaggañāṇāsinā hatattā for all slain by the arahat path. No drift; nothing imported from Müller’s note (D’Alwis’s lust, pride, heretical systems, sensual pleasure). XXI.4 is Burlingame’s story of Lakuṇṭaka Bhaddiya on 294 to 295. Plain sense true to day.js 294 and states the killing in one plain clause, neither softened nor sensationalised; no four-word run from the key. The only change, ‘on verse 294’ in s and src, is a correct verse place. verse.js ok (Dhammapada 294, at 293); entry-check ok, no warnings.
